title: 第17章 还来第18章 为他而来
content_zh:
第17章还来！
周凌雪气息旺盛，苦海传出惊涛骇浪般的声响，似有光束从天垂落，降临在她的身上。
远风城有史以来最年轻的苦海九重强者！
人群皆叹，在远风城，苦海九重境可开辟一座强盛的家族，周凌雪如此年轻就达到了这一境界，其前途，真的不可限量了！
事实上，众人也清楚，苦海八重的周凌雪便可击败九重强者，现在的她，战力应当达到了苦海之极！
也许，能够硬撼命桥境强者！
“我本不打算这么快突破到九重，想要稳固一下根基，但为了杀你，也顾不得这许多了！”
周凌雪双眸仿佛都闪烁着可怕的赤凰印记，一尊巨大的赤凰虚影出现在她身后，仿佛与她浑然一体。
这一刻的周凌雪，释放出的气息竟不逊色于命桥境多少了，她的脚步朝前迈出，双手捏着可怕法诀。
刹那之间，数道赤凰之剑浮现，裹挟炽盛烈焰，伴随着周凌雪的玉指向前一击，数十柄赤凰之剑同时朝着萧沉爆杀而出，恐怖的剑意划破空间，让众人头皮都有些发麻。
“是稳固根基，还是无法彻底融合道骨？”
萧沉冷笑了一声，催动不死天功，他的身上仿佛都覆盖上了一层战神铠甲，流转璀璨的斗战之光！
轰！
哪怕面对苦海九重的周凌雪，萧沉的拳头还是一往无前地扫荡而出，那股拳意似能崩灭一切，轰向了赤凰之剑。
双方攻击碰撞的瞬间，拳印和赤凰之剑同时爆裂，恐怖的余波朝着萧沉席卷而来，吹打着萧沉的长袍。
显然，这一击，萧沉略逊一筹。
毕竟，他和周凌雪相隔了四重小境界，而且对方还是先天道体，觉醒了道骨的力量。
“再吃我一剑！”
周凌雪叱喝，身后赤凰虚影啸天而起，只见她双手凝印，那巨大的赤凰虚影化作数十丈长的巨剑，散发着炙热的高温，犹如神凰火焰般，从高空径直劈杀而下，要将萧沉立劈成两半！
萧沉的神情有些凝重，战斗气息澎湃，一尊睥睨十方的战神虚影浮现在他身后，那战神的相貌，竟和萧沉一般无二。

这是战王拳，萧沉从那伟岸存在的传承中领悟而来，是一门至刚至烈的强大拳法，修炼到极尽，化身战神，纵踏古今。
当然，以萧沉目前的修为，还无法真正发挥出这拳法的威力，只是初窥门径罢了。
饶是如此，此刻萧沉释放出的战意，也让众人感到心惊。
“斩！”
周凌雪暴喝。
“灭！”
萧沉口吐一字，轰出的拳头仿佛都烙印着“战”
字，金色血气冲霄，他如同天生的战斗王者，打出了苦海境至强的一击！
这一瞬，远风城的所有人眼眸都凝固住了，尤其是周狂昭、冷家之主等苦海九重强者。
萧沉的这一拳，已经足以威胁到他们了！
苦海五重，却拥有九重境的战力！
轰隆隆！
战拳与巨剑对轰，战台中间都出现了一道裂痕，众人耳边传来山呼海啸般的声响，不知是萧沉的苦海，还是周凌雪的苦海。
尘土飞扬，让众人都有些看不清战台上的情形。
白念冰抓着衣角，有些替萧沉担心。
烟尘散去，萧沉站在原地，嘴角却溢出了一丝血迹，似乎受了不小的伤。
看到这一幕，周狂昭舒了一口气，看来，这一战将没有悬念了。
“现在跪下磕头，我会让你死得痛快一点。”
周凌雪的气息有些浮动，刚才那赤凰一剑，对她的消耗也不小。
“我说过，这一战，我会拿回属于我的一切。”
content_en:
Chapter 17 is coming again!
Zhou Lingxue's aura was strong, and a sound like a stormy sea came from the sea of ​​suffering, as if a beam of light fell from the sky and landed on her.
The youngest ninth-level powerhouse in the history of Yuanfeng City!
The crowd all sighed. In Yuanfeng City, the ninth level of Bitter Sea can create a strong family. Zhou Lingxue has reached this level at such a young age, and his future is really limitless!
In fact, everyone also knows that Zhou Lingxue, who is at the eighth level of the Sea of ​​Bitterness, can defeat a strong man of the ninth level. Now her combat power should have reached the extreme level of the Sea of ​​Bitterness!
Perhaps, it can challenge the strong ones in the Life Bridge Realm!
"I didn't plan to break through to the ninth level so quickly. I wanted to solidify my foundation, but in order to kill you, I don't care about this much!"
Zhou Lingxue's eyes seemed to be flashing with the terrifying red phoenix mark, and a huge red phoenix shadow appeared behind her, as if it was integrated with her.
At this moment, the aura Zhou Lingxue released was not inferior to that of the Life Bridge Realm. She stepped forward, holding the terrifying magic formula in both hands.
In an instant, several red phoenix swords appeared, wrapped in blazing flames. As Zhou Lingxue's jade finger struck forward, dozens of red phoenix swords burst out towards Xiao Chen at the same time. The terrifying sword intent cut through the space, making everyone's scalp numb.
"Is it a solid foundation, or is it unable to completely fuse the Tao bones?"
Xiao Chen sneered and activated the Immortal Art. His body seemed to be covered with a layer of God of War armor, and the bright light of battle flowed!
boom!
Even when facing Zhou Lingxue, who was at the ninth level of the Sea of ​​Bitterness, Xiao Chen's fist still swept forward unwaveringly. That fist power seemed to be able to destroy everything and hit the Red Phoenix Sword.
The moment the two sides' attacks collided, the fist seal and the Red Phoenix Sword exploded at the same time, and the terrifying aftermath swept towards Xiao Chen, beating Xiao Chen's robe.
Obviously, Xiao Chen was slightly inferior to this attack.
After all, he and Zhou Lingxue were separated by four minor realms, and the other party was still an innate Tao body and had awakened the power of Tao bones.
"Take my sword again!"
Zhou Lingxue shouted, and the red phoenix shadow behind her rose up into the sky. She could see her hands forming seals. The huge red phoenix shadow turned into a giant sword dozens of feet long, exuding scorching heat, like the flames of the divine phoenix, and slashed straight down from the sky, trying to split Xiao Chenli in half!
Xiao Chen's expression was a little solemn, and the aura of fighting was surging. A shadow of the God of War looming over him appeared behind him. The appearance of the God of War was exactly the same as Xiao Chen's.
This is the King of War Fist. Xiao Chen learned it from the inheritance of that stalwart being. It is a powerful and powerful boxing technique. After practicing it to the extreme, he transformed into the God of War and traveled throughout the past and present.
Of course, with Xiao Chen's current level of cultivation, he is still unable to truly unleash the power of this boxing technique. He is just getting a glimpse of it.
Even so, the fighting spirit released by Xiao Chen at this moment also frightened everyone.
"Cut!"
Zhou Lingxue drank violently.
"Destroy!"
Xiao Chen uttered one word, and the punches he fired seemed to be branded with "fight"
Words, golden blood soaring into the sky, he was like a born fighting king, striking the most powerful blow in the Sea of Bitter Realm!
At this moment, the eyes of everyone in Yuanfeng City froze, especially Zhou Kuangzhao, the leader of the Leng family and other ninth-level powerhouses in the Sea of ​​Bitterness.
Xiao Chen's punch was enough to threaten them!
The fifth level of the sea of ​​suffering, but possesses the combat power of the ninth level!
Boom!
The battle fists and giant swords clashed, and a crack appeared in the middle of the battle platform. A sound like a roaring mountain and a tsunami could be heard in everyone's ears. They didn't know if it was Xiao Chen's sea of ​​suffering or Zhou Lingxue's sea of ​​suffering.
The dust was flying, making it difficult for everyone to see clearly what was happening on the battlefield.
Bai Nianbing grabbed the corner of his clothes, a little worried for Xiao Chen.
When the smoke and dust dispersed, Xiao Chen stood there, with a trace of blood spilling from the corner of his mouth, as if he had suffered a lot of injuries.
Seeing this scene, Zhou Kuangzhao breathed a sigh of relief. It seemed that there would be no suspense in this battle.
"Kneel down and kowtow now, and I will let you die a happy death."
Zhou Lingxue's breath was a little fluctuating.That red phoenix sword had taken quite a toll on her.
"I said that in this battle, I will get back everything that belongs to me."
